entities.summary: Carl Larsson-gården is the name given to Lilla Hyttnäs, a house located in the village of Sundborn outside Falun in Dalarna. The artists Carl Larsson and Karin Larsson lived here between the years 1889 and 1912. Since 1946, Lilla Hyttnäs has been managed by Carl and Karin Larsson's estate, as a historic home and museum.
